lines.en: Or to see their features. They're tiny, infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 即使放大，也很难看清它们的特征，它们太小了，小到让你怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到它们，它们会……

lines.en: The Pen not here either. Tom Thomas, are you looking for me?
lines.zh: 笔也不在这里，汤姆·托马斯，你在找我吗？

lines.en: Oh! No, for a red pen. I need it right now.
lines.zh: 不，我在找一支红笔，我现在就需要它。

lines.en: What do you need it for? Here.
lines.zh: 你要它做什么？

lines.en: Look what my teacher wrote in my assignment book.
lines.zh: 看看我老师在我的作业本上写了什么

lines.en: Bad behavior during the lesson. Fidgeting and talking.
lines.zh: 上课表现不好，坐立不安，说话

lines.en: What are you going to do with the red pen?
lines.zh: 你打算怎么处理这支红笔？

lines.en: Your teacher left something out?
lines.zh: 你老师漏写了什么

lines.en: I thought maybe, you know, I could fix it a bit.
lines.zh: 我想也许我可以稍微修改一下。

lines.en: I hope I find that pen.
lines.zh: 我希望我能找到那支笔。

lines.en: Oh, wow! Good catch!
lines.zh: 哦，什么？哦，哇，好眼力！

lines.en: So, what do you want to fix on it?
lines.zh: 所以你想修改什么？

lines.en: I'll just add a couple of no's,
lines.zh: 我只要加几个鼻子

lines.en: and then it will say that I had no bad behavior during the lesson,
lines.zh: 然后它就会显示我上课表现良好

lines.en: no fidgeting, and no talking. See? No problem!
lines.zh: 没有坐立不安，也没有说话。你看

lines.en: Cool! And then add this at the end.
lines.zh: 没问题。酷！

lines.en: Tom Thomas is the best! He's a perfect student!
lines.zh: 然后在最后加上这句话：托马斯是个完美的学生。不

lines.en: Nah, then they would guess I did it.
lines.zh: 那样他们会猜是我写的。

lines.en: What, is it clogged up?
lines.zh: 怎么了？

lines.en: A little scribble will do it.
lines.zh: 堵塞了？随便涂几笔就行了。

lines.en: That's not a pen, it's more like a pen knife.
lines.zh: 那不是…… 一支笔？它更像是一把小刀。

lines.en: Oh, look! The ball is missing! What ball?
lines.zh: 哦，看，笔尖的钢珠不见了。什么钢珠？

lines.en: It's a pen! It's a pen, but it's a ballpoint pen!
lines.zh: 这是一支笔，但它是一支圆珠笔。

lines.en: Old -fashioned pens work by dipping the pen into a jar of ink.
lines.zh: 老式钢笔需要蘸墨水才能使用

lines.en: But with a ballpoint pen,
lines.zh: 但圆珠笔的墨水储存在一个笔管里

lines.en: the ink is stored inside of a tube that has
lines.zh: 笔管末端有一个金属笔尖

lines.en: a metal tip on the end with a small steel ball.
lines.zh: 上面有一个小钢珠。

lines.en: Well, small for humans that is, but of course for Fixies it's quite large.
lines.zh: 对人来说很小，但对骑固定齿轮自行车的人来说，它就相当大了。

lines.en: When you drag the pen across the paper,
lines.zh: 当你用笔在纸上划过时

lines.en: the ball spins around and gets ink on it from inside the tube.
lines.zh: 钢珠会旋转，从笔管里沾上墨水

lines.en: Then it turns over and the ink rolls out onto the paper.
lines.zh: 然后翻转过来，墨水滚到纸上。所以

lines.en: So without the ball, a ballpoint pen won't write at all!
lines.zh: 如果没有钢珠，圆珠笔就写不出字了。

lines.en: So, what am I going to do?
lines.zh: 那我该怎么办？

lines.en: That's my only red pen.
lines.zh: 这是我唯一一支红笔。

lines.en: Hi everybody! Why do you look so sad?
lines.zh: 大家好，你们为什么看起来这么难过？

lines.en: We lost the ball from the tip of this pen.
lines.zh: 呃，我们把这支笔尖上的钢珠弄丢了

lines.en: Where? It's here somewhere.
lines.zh: 它应该在这里的某个地方。

lines.en: Then you're in luck, boys. In the pack -o -map there's a metal detector.
lines.zh: 那你们运气真好，伙计们，在便携式金属垫里有一个金属探测器

lines.en: You can use it to find different kinds of metal objects.
lines.zh: 你们可以用它来寻找各种金属物品。

lines.en: No, that's not it. I can see that myself.
lines.zh: 不是那个，我自己也看到了。

lines.en: It's not on the table, Nolik. Until not that long ago,
lines.zh: 它不在考虑范围内。直到不久前

lines.en: humans used pens that had to be
lines.zh: 人类使用的钢笔

lines.en: dipped over and over again into an inkwell.
lines.zh: 需要反复蘸墨水

lines.en: This was quite inconvenient.
lines.zh: 这很不方便。

lines.en: And so to make writing easier, the fountain pen was invented.
lines.zh: 为了方便书写，人们发明了钢笔。

lines.en: A fountain pen could be used to make a fountain pen.
lines.zh: 钢笔可以装满墨水

lines.en: filled up with ink so it could write for a much longer time.
lines.zh: 因此可以书写更长时间。

lines.en: But fountain pens would often leak, leaving blots of ink on the paper.
lines.zh: 但是钢笔经常漏墨，导致纸上残留大量墨水。

lines.en: This problem was solved with the invention of the ballpoint pen.
lines.zh: 圆珠笔的发明解决了这个问题。

lines.en: Ballpoint pens are simple, handy, and reliable,
lines.zh: 圆珠笔简单、方便、可靠

lines.en: except that you can't write with them on
lines.zh: 只是不能

lines.en: a wall or upside down for a long time.
lines.zh: 长时间在墙上或倒置书写

lines.en: That's because the ball uses up the ink on it,
lines.zh: 因为笔尖的钢珠会消耗掉上面的墨水

lines.en: and the ink can't flow up to the tip.
lines.zh: 导致墨水无法流到笔尖。

lines.en: But even this problem has been solved.
lines.zh: 但即使是这个问题也得到了解决。

lines.en: There are now special ball -point pens that
lines.zh: 现在有特殊圆珠笔

lines.en: can be used by astronauts floating in space.
lines.zh: 宇航员在太空漂浮时可以使用

lines.en: Is this the one? You're right! That's it!
lines.zh: 是这支吗？你说得对，就是它。

lines.en: Don't you just see how awesome my metal detector is?
lines.zh: 你没看到我的金属探测器有多棒吗？

lines.en: Is that what you're calling me now?
lines.zh: 你现在是在叫我金属探测器吗？

lines.en: Tom Thomas, help us!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，帮帮我们。

lines.en: And now! Tideesh! Cool!
lines.zh: 酷。

lines.en: By the way, what do you need the red pen for?
lines.zh: 对了，你需要什么？红色嗯

lines.en: Well, Tom Thomas and I need to fix something in his assignment book. What?!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯和我得帮他修改一下作业本。

lines.en: If I knew that, I would have done it myself!
lines.zh: 如果我知道的话

lines.en: Dad, I wouldn't have helped you out! So no fidgeting and no talking.
lines.zh: 我就不会帮你了。所以别乱动，也别说话。

lines.en: And your teacher, she writes in your assignment book when you behave well?
lines.zh: 嗯，你的老师会在你表现好的时候在你的作业本上写点什么。嗯哼

lines.en: Whenever we behave well, she writes a note in our books right away.
lines.zh: 我们表现好的时候，她会马上在我们的作业本上写点什么。

lines.en: Did you see, Simka, how Tom Thomas managed to outsmart everybody?
lines.zh: 啊，你看到辛查了吗？汤姆·托马斯是怎么耍了所有人的？

lines.en: Since I see nothing else here from your teacher,
lines.zh: 因为我没看到你老师的其他留言

lines.en: does that mean you behaved badly the other days?
lines.zh: 那是不是意味着你前几天表现不好？

lines.en: What?! Well, uh...
lines.zh: 嗯哼。什么？嗯

lines.en: Did you see, Nolik, how Tom Thomas just managed to outsmart himself?
lines.zh: 你看到了吗？没有，看看汤姆·托马斯是怎么耍自己的。互相
